column1: # Altin: the water beasts and the rain that does not stop.

column3: Is this your first time\nto visit Altin?{end_now}

Look at what has become
of Altin.{page_break}Nothing can be done
here until the water
goes down.{end_wait}
We look like a coastal\ntown now, don't we?{end_now}

Nothing gets by you.
Altin never even had a
well in the old days.{page_break}Now the water-spewing
beasts and the rain
have drowned us.{end_wait}

The day the gems fell
from the sky{pause_20_skippable}, these
water beasts appeared.{page_break}Then the rain started
and never stopped.
We are finished.{end_wait}
How can those creatures\nspit up so much water?{end_wait}
My house is soaked\nthrough. The monsters\nand the rain did it.{end_wait}
Even the mine is\nsubmerged. No one can\nwork. No one can eat.{end_wait}
If someone destroyed\nthe monsters, the water\nmight drain away.{end_wait}

Altin always ran short
of water. Now we drown.{page_break}We have bad luck
with water, one way
or the other.{end_wait}

We cannot drink what the
monsters spew, or the
rain. It is all foul.{page_break}Will no one slay
those beasts?{end_wait}

The water here has
subsided...{page_break}I wonder if the holes in
the mine drained it.
The rain still falls.{end_wait}

The water beasts looked
like Altin's guardian
statues...{page_break}Did the guardians turn
into the monsters
when the light came?{end_wait}

The water flushed tons
of rock out of the mine.{page_break}Maybe we will find
gems no one has ever
seen before.{end_wait}
You came to Altin at\na bad time. Terrible\nluck, you strangers.{end_wait}
It is as if they turn\nthe air itself into\nwater!{end_wait}
I saved my first love\nletter, but what about\neverything else?{end_wait}
Even our toughest miners\ncannot work in this\nwater.{end_wait}
If the water beasts\nkeep flooding us,{page_break}the whole village\nwill go under.{end_wait}
Water is nice, but not\nwhen it takes your home.{end_wait}
Ugh. The monsters\nspewed all this water.\nIt smells foul...{end_wait}

As the monsters go away,
the waters recede.{page_break}Perhaps all of them
will be gone soon.
The rain, though...{end_wait}
Come to think of it,\nour guardian statue\nseemed to spew water.{end_wait}
It beats digging up\nmore of those cursed\nancient relics.{end_wait}
Oh no... The whole\nhouse is soaked...{end_wait}

If the monster that did
this were here, I would
give him a smack!{page_break}Just kidding... I
am against violence.
Mostly.{end_wait}
It will take a lot of\nwork to repair this\nhouse.{end_wait}
One blow is not enough.\nJab! Jab! Hook! Then\ncomes the uppercut!{end_wait}
Are you trying to find\nyour way west through\nthe mountains?{end_now}
There should be a\npassage at the bottom\nof the mine.{end_wait}
I do not know what you\ndid, but thank you for\ndefeating the beasts.{end_wait}
Do not be too harsh on\nthose beasts.{end_wait}
I thought the village was\ndone for. I am glad we\ndid not give up hope.{end_wait}
I am just glad to\nhave my house back.{end_wait}
I did not want to leave\nmy hometown...\nThat is why I came back.{end_wait}

I heard someone killed
the water beasts.
That is why I came back.{page_break}There is no place
like home.{end_wait}
You defeated those\nmonsters, didn't you?{end_now}
Here, let me thank\nyou with...a kiss!{page_break}Look, you are turning\nbeet-red!{end_wait}

Oh, you didn't? Still, I
am glad to be home,
so here is a kiss!{page_break}Look, you are turning
beet-red!{end_wait}

The bottom of the
mine, the end of the
easternmost passage...{page_break}I will not give
that up.{end_wait}

My husband's sense for
treasure never failed.{page_break}When the water recedes,
we will dig up the spot
he found.{end_wait}

Mom and Pop know
something about the
bottom of the mine.{page_break}I wish they would
tell me what it is.{end_wait}
Do you want weapons?{end_now}

I will sell you anything
once the waters have
receded.{page_break}What did we do
to deserve this?{end_wait}
You would not say that\nif you saw my weapons.\nI wish I could show you.{end_wait}
Thank goodness the water\nhas receded. I can open\nthe shop again!{end_wait}
Cripes... Is this how\nmy weapon shop ends,\nas a sunken wreck?{end_wait}
Only a merchant knows\nthe joy of opening the\ndoors again.{end_wait}
My store is submerged.\nI want to sell armor,\nbut I cannot.{end_wait}
It is good to sell\narmor out of my own\nshop again.{end_wait}
All my armor is rusting\nas we speak.{end_wait}
We dried all the armor\nand polished it.{page_break}There should be no\ntrace of rust now.{end_wait}
Oh no! What will I do\nif all my merchandise\nis soaked?{end_wait}
None of my goods were\ndamaged. I will sell\nlike there is no tomorrow!{end_wait}
If my goods are wet, I\nhave to dry them out\nbefore I can sell them.{end_wait}

A few things got damp...{page_break}It should not affect
the quality, so you can
use them safely.{page_break}...Maybe I should put
up a sign to say so.{end_wait}
We got a little damp, but\nwe are doing okay. We\nmust count our blessings.{end_now}
After all, many good\npeople were hurt in\nthis flood.{end_wait}

Remember, many people
lost everything they
own.{page_break}It is sad, when you
think about it.{end_wait}

I would give anything
for someone to return
Altin to what it was.{page_break}You look young, but if
you are true warriors,
please help us.{end_wait}
I came from Xian.\nI cook good food.\nEat up!{end_wait}
None of us can go\nhome until the\nwater subsides.{end_wait}
The guests in Room One\nwent home when the\nwaters receded.{end_wait}
The guests in Room Two\nalso went home when the\nwaters receded.{end_wait}
We will get through\nthis, but I fear the\nvillage is done for.{end_wait}

I know they do not look
tough, but they are
warriors,{page_break}so maybe they can
help us.{end_wait}
I became a cook after\nI came to Altin, but I\nstill cook well.{end_wait}

Most of the village is
still submerged...{page_break}It will be a long time
before Altin is what
it was.{end_wait}

The water has receded
a little,{page_break}but it will be a long
time before Altin is
what it was.{end_wait}
No matter what happens,\nI will never abandon\nAltin.{end_wait}
Our house is ruined\nnow, of course.{page_break}I wish I could\nmove away...{end_wait}
Leaving Altin for Tolbi?\nThat is just crazy.\nThe whole world is wet.{end_wait}
Now I finally have an\nexcuse to move to my\nfavorite town{em_dash}Tolbi!{end_wait}
Few people come up\nSilk Road to Altin.\nYou are an odd lot.{end_wait}
It has been a long time\nsince I got a break from\nhousework. Funny.{end_wait}
You cannot go west\nof the mountains\nwithout Silk Road.{end_wait}
I hate sitting around\nlike this. I want to\ngo home!{end_wait}
Thank you for defeating\nthe hydros statues\nin the mine.{end_wait}
Did you see water gush\nout when you slew those\nhydros creatures?{end_now}
I see... So the water\nmonsters were like\ngiant water tanks...{end_wait}
Really... Then how did\nthey carry all that\nwater?{end_wait}
Once the mine opens\nagain, we will get back\non our feet.{end_wait}

They have started mining
the upper parts of the
mountain.{page_break}People are still afraid
to go down to the
lower depths.{end_wait}

The water drained out
through the cracks,
as I expected.{page_break}The rain still falls,
and the remaining water
will sit for a while.{end_wait}
Thank goodness the\nvillage is free of\nthe monsters' water.{end_wait}
Are you the ones who\ndefeated the water\nbeasts?{end_now}
We would be obliged if\nyou would also help\nrebuild the village.{end_wait}
I heard our rescuers\nwere young. I would like\nto meet them.{end_wait}

The village went back to
normal once the water
monsters left.{page_break}But the rain keeps
making a mess.{end_wait}
So those hydros\ncreatures really were\nthe guardian statues?{page_break}That is a surprise.{end_wait}
Is it true you found\nancient ruins in the\ndeepest part of the mine?{end_now}
Really? I always thought\nthat mine held some kind\nof secret.{end_wait}
Hmm, are you sure you\nwent down there?{page_break}Someone ought to\ngo and check.{end_wait}
We can go back to\nwork in the mines\nagain.{end_wait}
I feared more water\nwould gush out when the\nmonsters were slain.{end_wait}
I hope Altin Mine\nthrives again soon,\nlike it once did.{end_wait}
The water seeped into\nthe mine shafts.{page_break}I bet the rock is\nvery soft now.{end_wait}
It is so humid inside\nthat cave. It feels\nawful and sticky!{end_wait}
That strange chamber in\nthe mines creeps me out.{end_wait}
You fought well despite\nall the foul water\nthe beasts spewed.{end_wait}
That mine is full of\nholes and chasms.\nThat is why it drained.{end_wait}
The old guardian statues\nalways creeped me out.\nI am glad they are gone.{end_wait}
I used to find all sorts\nof artifacts. I wonder if\nthey came from the ruins.{end_wait}
I hear Silk Road is\nclosed...{page_break}At least that is what\nthis girl from Xian said.{end_wait}

A girl from Xian was
asking about young
warriors.{page_break}Say, could she have
meant you?{end_now}
She was searching\nvery hard.{end_wait}
If not, I hope she finds\nwhoever she was looking\nfor.{end_wait}

The merchants must be
hurting if Silk Road is
blocked.{page_break}Who could clear away
a landslide in this
rain?{end_wait}
I wonder what business\nthat girl from Xian has\nwith warriors...{end_wait}
Ancient ruins and\ntreasure go together...{page_break}What are you going\nto do?{end_wait}
If only they had left a\nwater monster or two...{end_wait}

They say you can still
find monsters if you
go deep in the mine.{page_break}I would go hunting
treasure if not for
those beasts.{end_wait}
How can I be happy when\nall those cute monsters\nare gone?{end_wait}
Really? Ancient ruins at\nthe bottom of the mine?\nYou do not say...{end_wait}

There is probably not
much treasure in the
ruins beneath the mine.{page_break}Why not forget the
treasure and continue
your journey?{end_wait}

Something is wrong with
Mom and Pop. They have
been acting strange{page_break}ever since the ruins
were found in the mine.{end_wait}
Cripes. Ancient ruins\ndown in the mine...{page_break}We have to go get that\ntreasure right away.{end_wait}
I had no idea there were\nruins beneath the mine.{end_wait}
I wonder if Mom and Pop\nknew about the monument\nin the mine.{end_wait}

You will have to find
the passage in the mine
that leads west{page_break}if Silk Road is
blocked.{end_wait}

I have heard of a
passage in the mine
that leads west, but{page_break}I have not met anyone
who found it.{end_wait}
How about it? Are you\nimpressed by our armor\nselection?{end_wait}
If you are impressed,\nthen buy something!{end_wait}
The girl from Xian\nbought a lot. Is she on\na journey?{end_wait}
The girl from Xian\nbought all the goods\nthat had been submerged.{end_wait}

There is a small temple
west of Altin Mine.{page_break}They may have trouble
with the water from
the mine.{end_wait}

An endless desert lies
west of the mountains.{page_break}Travelers going west
must prepare themselves
well.{end_wait}

West of the mountains
is very{em_dash}very hot!
It is exhausting.{page_break}Eat hot food. It helps
you endure the heat.{end_wait}
A few beasts remain in\nthe mine, but they are\ndown deep, right?{end_now}
Good. Then we can mine\nthe upper passages.{end_wait}
If they are in the upper\npassages, we cannot\nmine as we used to.{end_wait}

I think that temple was
called Lama Temple.{page_break}They say people with
strange powers live
there.{end_wait}
You cannot go to the\ndesert for a while.\nSilk Road is blocked.{end_wait}
No one can go west of\nthe mountains now.{end_wait}
It will take time for\nAltin to recover\nfrom this.{end_wait}
The pots and pans\nare rusted...{end_wait}
